schemes.name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana
schemes.nameLocal: नमो शेतकरी महासन्मान निधी योजना (अतिरिक्त ₹6,000 वार्षिक)
schemes.summary: Maharashtra State Government top-up scheme that adds ₹6,000 per year directly to PM-KISAN eligible farmers, providing a total of ₹12,000 annual direct cash support.
schemes.targetFarmers: All PM-KISAN registered landholding farmers in Maharashtra
schemes.eligibility: Farmers resident in Maharashtra whose 7/12 land records are verified and who receive PM-KISAN installments.
schemes.benefits: ₹6,000/year delivered in 3 equal installments (₹2,000 each) directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts without separate physical application.
applicationSteps: Beneficiary list is auto-mapped from verified PM-KISAN data on mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in.
Ensure your 7/12 land record is seeded with Aadhaar at your local Talathi or CSC.
Verify payment credit status on MahaDBT farmer portal.
schemes.howToApply: Auto-credited for PM-KISAN beneficiaries in Maharashtra. Queries at local Talathi or Krishi Sahayak.

schemes.name: MahaDBT Krishi Yantrikaran & Shet Tale Anudan
schemes.nameLocal: महाडीबीटी शेततळे अस्तरीकरण व कृषी यांत्रिकीकरण (50% ते 75% अनुदान)
schemes.summary: High-subsidy scheme for farm ponds (shet tale with plastic lining up to ₹75,000), tractors (₹1.25 Lakh subsidy), rotavators, power tillers, and onion storage sheds (kanda chawl).
schemes.subsidyHighlight: Up to 75% Subsidy (Tractors, Shet Tale, Kanda Chawl)
schemes.targetFarmers: Small, marginal, and progressive farmers of Maharashtra
schemes.eligibility: Farmers with valid Maharashtra 7/12 land records. SC/ST and women farmers receive highest subsidy priority.
schemes.benefits: Direct subsidy on tractor (up to ₹1.25 Lakh), rotavator (₹35,000), farm pond lining (₹75,000), and onion storage structure (₹87,500).
documentsRequired: Self-declaration of not availing same machine subsidy in last 10 years
applicationSteps: Login on MahaDBT portal (mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in) with Aadhaar.
Select 'Farmer Schemes' -> 'Agricultural Mechanization' or 'Irrigation Facility'.
Pay nominal ₹23.60 application fee and participate in weekly computerized lottery.
On lottery selection, upload dealer quotation, receive pre-sanction, purchase equipment and claim DBT.
schemes.howToApply: Online via MahaDBT portal or Common Service Centre (CSC / Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra).

schemes.name: UP Free Boring & Solar Tubewell Scheme
schemes.nameLocal: उत्तर प्रदेश निःशुल्क बोरिंग योजना व नलकूप अनुदान
schemes.summary: Uttar Pradesh Minor Irrigation scheme providing 100% free shallow boring for small and marginal farmers, with grants up to ₹10,000 for pumpset installation and diesel-to-solar conversions.
schemes.ministry: Minor Irrigation Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
schemes.targetFarmers: Small and marginal farmers holding up to 2 hectares in UP
schemes.eligibility: Permanent resident farmers of UP possessing minimum 0.2 hectare cultivable land without dark-zone ground water restrictions.
schemes.benefits: Free boring boring pipe and labor costs provided by department. General farmers get ₹5,000 subsidy on pump purchase; SC/ST farmers get ₹10,000 subsidy.
applicationSteps: Apply online via upagripardarshi.gov.in or submit form to Block Development Officer (BDO).
Junior Engineer of Minor Irrigation inspects the proposed site.
Boring unit allocated and executed free of charge by department rig.
schemes.howToApply: Through Block Minor Irrigation Office or online at upagripardarshi.gov.in.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana (MP)
schemes.nameLocal: मुख्यमंत्री किसान कल्याण योजना (मध्यप्रदेश — अतिरिक्त ₹6,000 वार्षिक)
schemes.summary: Madhya Pradesh State Government direct cash benefit that supplements PM-KISAN with ₹6,000 per year, providing a combined ₹12,000 annual support to MP farmers.
schemes.ministry: Farmer Welfare & Agriculture Development, Government of MP
schemes.targetFarmers: All verified PM-KISAN beneficiary farmers in Madhya Pradesh
schemes.eligibility: Landholding farmers of MP who are active beneficiaries of PM-KISAN scheme.
schemes.benefits: ₹6,000 deposited in 3 installments of ₹2,000 directly into Aadhaar-linked accounts.
applicationSteps: Registration is verified by Patwari through SAARA portal (saara.mp.gov.in).
Farmers already on PM-KISAN are automatically integrated upon Patwari verification.
schemes.howToApply: Verified via local Patwari / Tehsildar or on saara.mp.gov.in.

schemes.name: Rajasthan Khet Tarbandi Anudan Yojana
schemes.nameLocal: राजस्थान खेत तारबंदी योजना (50% से 60% अनुदान — ₹48,000 तक)
schemes.summary: Financial subsidy to fence agricultural fields with barbed wire (up to 400 meters) to protect standing crops from stray cattle, blue bulls (Neelgai), and wild boars.
schemes.ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of Rajasthan
schemes.targetFarmers: Individual farmers with min 1.5 Ha or groups with min 5 Ha land in Rajasthan
schemes.eligibility: Individual small/marginal farmers with 1.5 hectares or group of 2+ farmers with 5 hectares contiguous land.
schemes.benefits: 50% cost of fencing up to ₹40,000 for general farmers; 60% up to ₹48,000 for small and marginal farmers across max 400 meters boundary.
applicationSteps: Login to RajKisan Sathi portal (rajkisan.rajasthan.gov.in) via SSO ID.
Fill Tarbandi application and attach Jamabandi and field trace map.
Agriculture Supervisor conducts physical verification of field boundaries.
Construct fencing, geo-tagged photo taken, subsidy credited to bank account.
schemes.howToApply: Online through RajKisan Sathi portal or nearest e-Mitra kiosk.

schemes.name: Punjab Crop Residue Management (CRM) Subsidy
schemes.nameLocal: पंजाब पराली प्रबंधन कृषि यंत्र सब्सिडी (सुपर सीडर पर 50% से 80% छूट)
schemes.summary: Subsidies on crop residue management machines: Super Seeder, Smart Seeder, Happy Seeder, Mulcher, and Paddy Straw Chopper to eliminate stubble burning.
schemes.ministry: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Punjab
schemes.targetFarmers: Individual farmers, cooperative societies, and panchayats in Punjab
schemes.eligibility: Farmers cultivating paddy in Punjab owning a registered tractor of 45-65 HP capacity.
schemes.benefits: 50% subsidy for individual farmers on Super Seeder (saving ~₹1.2 Lakh); 80% subsidy for Primary Agriculture Cooperative Societies (PACS) and Panchayats setting up Custom Hiring Centers.
applicationSteps: Apply on agrimachinerypb.com during open portal window.
Select machinery type and preferred authorized manufacturer.
District level committee sanctions application through lottery.
Purchase machine from approved empanelled vendor and receive physical verification for subsidy release.
schemes.howToApply: Online on agrimachinerypb.com or through Chief Agriculture Officer (CAO).

schemes.name: Bihar Rajya Fasal Sahayata Yojana (BRFSY)
schemes.nameLocal: बिहार राज्य फसल सहायता योजना (शून्य प्रीमियम — ₹10,000 प्रति हेक्टेयर सहायता)
schemes.summary: Completely free crop loss financial assistance scheme by Bihar Government for flood, drought, or unseasonal weather damage with zero insurance premium required from farmers.
schemes.ministry: Department of Agriculture & Cooperative, Government of Bihar
schemes.targetFarmers: Raiyat (landowners) and Gair-Raiyat (tenant/sharecropper) farmers in Bihar
schemes.eligibility: All cultivating farmers of Bihar who register before the crop season cut-off date. Both owner and tenant farmers eligible.
schemes.benefits: ₹7,500 per hectare for yield loss up to 20%; ₹10,000 per hectare for yield loss greater than 20% (up to 2 hectares per farmer). Zero premium payable.
documentsRequired: Aadhaar Card and Bihar Kisan Registration Number
LPC (Land Possession Certificate) or Revenue Receipt for owners
Self-declaration attested by Ward Member / Mukhiya for tenant farmers
applicationSteps: Register on dbtagriculture.bihar.gov.in or pacsbihar.nic.in.
Upload crop sowing self-declaration and land record copy.
In case of block-level yield deficit, financial assistance credited directly to bank account.
schemes.howToApply: Online via Cooperative Department portal (pacsonline.bih.nic.in) or DBT Agriculture Bihar.

schemes.name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
schemes.nameLocal: प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधि (₹6,000 वार्षिक DBT)
schemes.summary: 100% Central government funded direct financial assistance of ₹6,000 per year transferred directly into bank accounts in 3 equal four-monthly installments of ₹2,000 each.
schemes.targetFarmers: All landholding farmer families across India
schemes.eligibility: Farmer families with cultivable landholding in revenue records. Institutional landholders, serving/retired government officers, and income taxpayers are excluded.
schemes.benefits: ₹6,000 per year delivered in 3 installments (April-July, August-November, December-March). Guaranteed Aadhaar-seeded Direct Benefit Transfer with zero middlemen.
documentsRequired: Aadhaar Card of head of family & spouse
Updated Land Record (7/12, Khatauni / Jamabandi / ROR)
Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar linked & NPCI active)
Active Mobile Number for OTP authentication
applicationSteps: Visit pmkisan.gov.in and click on 'New Farmer Registration'.
Enter Aadhaar Number, select State, and verify with Aadhaar OTP.
Enter Land Khata/Khasra details and upload scanned land revenue copy.
Submit and track status in 'Beneficiary Status' with eKYC completion.
schemes.howToApply: Online via pmkisan.gov.in, nearest Common Service Center (CSC), or Patwari / Village Agricultural Officer.

schemes.name: PM-KUSUM (Solar Agricultural Pumps)
schemes.nameLocal: पीएम-कुसुम योजना (सोलर कृषि पंप पर 60% से 90% सब्सिडी)
schemes.summary: Massive government subsidy to install standalone off-grid or grid-connected solar agricultural water pumps (3 HP to 10 HP) and solarize existing diesel or electric pumps.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
schemes.targetFarmers: Individual farmers, groups, water user associations, and FPOs across India
schemes.eligibility: Farmers with agricultural land having an irrigation water source (borewell, dugwell, farm pond, canal) without existing energized grid connection or seeking diesel replacement.
schemes.benefits: Central Government grants 30% subsidy, State Government contributes 30% to 60%, and Bank loans finance up to 30%. The farmer pays as little as 10% to 20% of total pump cost.
documentsRequired: Water Source Certificate / Underground Water Board NOC
applicationSteps: Open your State Renewable Energy Agency portal (e.g. Mahaurja in MH, HAREDA in HR, RREC in RJ).
Select PM-KUSUM Component-B (Standalone Solar Pump) registration.
Enter land details, pump capacity required (3HP, 5HP, or 7.5HP), and water table depth.
Pay farmer share (10%-20%) upon survey approval and choose pump manufacturer vendor.
schemes.howToApply: Apply online through State Renewable Energy Development Agencies or the central PM-KUSUM portal.

schemes.name: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
schemes.nameLocal: प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना (कम प्रीमियम में सम्पूर्ण फसल सुरक्षा)
schemes.summary: Comprehensive crop insurance shield protecting farmers from pre-sowing till post-harvest against unseasonal rainfall, floods, droughts, hailstorms, pest attacks, and localized cyclones.
schemes.targetFarmers: All farmers growing notified food grains, oilseeds, and horticultural crops
schemes.eligibility: Owner farmers, sharecroppers, and tenant farmers cultivating notified crops in notified administrative blocks.
schemes.benefits: Nominal premium: 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops. The remaining 80%-95% premium is fully subsidized by Central & State governments.
documentsRequired: Land Record (7/12, Khatauni or registered tenancy agreement)
Sowing Certificate issued by Patwari / Village Agricultural Officer
Bank Passbook copy with active IFSC code
applicationSteps: Visit pmfby.gov.in or download the Crop Insurance Mobile App before seasonal cut-off date.
Choose your State, District, Taluk, Season (Kharif/Rabi), and Crop.
Calculate premium and submit land survey & sowing proof.
In case of localized storm/flood damage, report loss within 72 hours via app or toll-free 14447.
schemes.howToApply: Online on pmfby.gov.in, nearest bank branch where you hold KCC, CSC center, or Agriculture Insurance Company agents.

schemes.name: PMKSY (Per Drop More Crop — Drip & Sprinkler)
schemes.nameLocal: प्रधानमंत्री कृषि सिंचाई योजना (ड्रिप व स्प्रिंकलर पर 45% से 55% अनुदान)
schemes.summary: State and Central joint subsidy scheme to install precision drip irrigation systems and portable/micro sprinklers to boost crop yields by 30-40% while saving 50% irrigation water.
schemes.subsidyHighlight: 45% to 55% Subsidy (Up to 80% for SC/ST/Small Farmers)
schemes.targetFarmers: Small, marginal and commercial orchard/vegetable growers across India
schemes.eligibility: Farmers having cultivable land with assured round-the-year water source (well, tubewell, farm pond). Special priority for women and SC/ST farmers.
schemes.benefits: 55% financial assistance for small/marginal farmers (<2 Ha) and 45% for other farmers. Enables fertigation directly to roots, reducing fertilizer waste by 35% and labor costs by 60%.
documentsRequired: Land Record (7/12 or Jamabandi with current year crop entry)
Aadhaar Card and Caste Certificate (for extra subsidy)
Farm Map / Field Sketch with water source location
Water & Soil Test Report from certified laboratory
applicationSteps: Register on your State Horticulture/Agriculture Micro-Irrigation portal (e.g. MahaDBT, e-Horticulture).
Upload land records and select registered vendor for field survey and GPS layout design.
Horticulture Officer reviews and issues administrative pre-sanction approval.
Vendor installs system; physical verification done; subsidy credited directly to bank/vendor account.
schemes.howToApply: Online through State Horticulture/Agriculture Portals or Block Assistant Director of Horticulture office.

schemes.name: SMAM (Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization)
schemes.nameLocal: कृषि यंत्रीकरण उप-अभियान (ट्रैक्टर, ड्रोन व आधुनिक यंत्रों पर 40% से 50% छूट)
schemes.summary: Subsidies on agricultural machinery including high-tech agricultural drones, laser land levelers, rotavators, power tillers, combine harvesters, and Custom Hiring Centers (CHC).
schemes.subsidyHighlight: 40% to 50% Subsidy (Up to ₹5 Lakh for CHC Drones)
schemes.targetFarmers: Individual farmers, farm youth entrepreneurs, FPOs, and Panchayats
schemes.eligibility: Farmers with valid land records. Priority given to small, marginal, women, and SC/ST farmers. Custom Hiring Centers eligible for up to 80% project subsidy.
schemes.benefits: Reduces cost of cultivation by 25% and human drudgery. Agricultural spray drones enable 1 acre spraying in 7 minutes using 90% less water and zero human chemical exposure.
documentsRequired: Aadhaar Card and Driving License / Identity Proof
Bank Passbook copy with active IFSC
Cast Certificate (if applicable for enhanced 50% bracket)
applicationSteps: Visit the Direct Benefit Transfer in Agricultural Mechanization portal: agrimachinery.nic.in.
Select 'Farmer Registration' and enter Aadhaar and Mobile Number.
Select Machine Category (e.g. Tractor, Power Weeder, Drone, Combine Harvester).
Upload quotation, receive lottery / queue sanction order, purchase machine, and claim subsidy.
schemes.howToApply: Online at agrimachinery.nic.in or through District Agricultural Engineering Officer.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) & Interest Subvention
schemes.nameLocal: किसान क्रेडिट कार्ड (4% रियायती ब्याज दर पर ₹3 लाख तक ऋण)
schemes.summary: Short-term agricultural working capital loan up to ₹3 Lakh at an effective concessional interest rate of just 4% per annum (with prompt repayment incentive), free from money lender traps.
schemes.subsidyHighlight: Effective 4% Low Interest Rate (Up to ₹1.6 Lakh Collateral-Free)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Finance & Reserve Bank of India (RBI)
schemes.targetFarmers: Owner cultivators, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, animal husbandry & fisheries farmers
schemes.eligibility: All farmers cultivating crops, maintaining milk cattle, poultry, or fish ponds. Age 18 to 75 years.
schemes.benefits: Base interest is 7%. Government gives 3% Prompt Repayment Incentive (PRI), bringing net interest down to 4% per year. Includes RuPay KCC Debit Card for instant cash withdrawals at any ATM.
documentsRequired: Duly filled one-page KCC Application Form
Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Voter ID
No-Dues Certificate / Affidavit of no unpaid loan from other banks
applicationSteps: Download one-page simple KCC form from pmkisan.gov.in or collect from your local bank branch.
Fill crop details, acreage, and attached land record verification.
Submit to your local Commercial Bank, Regional Rural Bank (RRB), or Cooperative Society.
Bank processes and issues RuPay KCC card within 14 working days.
schemes.howToApply: At any Public Sector Bank, Cooperative Bank, Regional Rural Bank, or online via bank portals.

schemes.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
schemes.nameLocal: मृदा स्वास्थ्य कार्ड योजना (मिट्टी की नि:शुल्क जांच व संतुलित खाद परामर्श)
schemes.summary: Free soil sample testing providing customized soil health report with 12 parameters (pH, EC, Organic Carbon, N, P, K, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, B) and tailored fertilizer recommendations.
schemes.targetFarmers: All farmers across all agro-ecological zones of India
schemes.eligibility: Every landholding farmer in India is entitled to a Soil Health Card updated every 3 years.
schemes.benefits: Prevents over-application of Urea and DAP, reducing input costs by 15-20% (₹2,500 to ₹4,000 per acre saved) while restoring soil vitality and boosting harvest yield by 8-10%.
documentsRequired: Khasra / Survey Number of the plot
Previous crop and planned upcoming crop information
applicationSteps: Soil samples are collected in a grid pattern (2.5 ha for irrigated, 10 ha for rainfed) by Agriculture Department or KVK.
Samples are tested in district Soil Testing Laboratories (STLs).
Printed or digital Soil Health Card is issued with crop-specific fertilizer dosage.
View and download your digital card anytime using Khasra number on soilhealth.dac.gov.in.
schemes.howToApply: Contact local Gram Sevak, Agriculture Assistant, Krishi Vigyan Kendra, or check online at soilhealth.dac.gov.in.

schemes.name: PKVY (Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana)
schemes.nameLocal: परम्परागत कृषि विकास योजना (प्राकृतिक व जैविक खेती हेतु ₹50,000 प्रति हेक्टेयर)
schemes.summary: Cluster-based promotion of traditional organic and zero-budget natural farming without synthetic pesticides or chemical fertilizers, with PGS organic certification and direct marketing.
schemes.targetFarmers: Farmers forming clusters of 20 to 50 hectares
schemes.eligibility: Individual farmers forming a group/cluster willing to adopt organic farming practices and PGS-India certification for a minimum period of 3 years.
schemes.benefits: ₹31,000/ha is directly transferred to farmers for organic inputs (biopesticides, neem cake, vermicompost, jeevamrit), plus ₹8,800/ha for post-harvest packaging, branding, and marketing.
documentsRequired: Aadhaar Card and Land Records of group members
Bank Account in cluster name or individual DBT accounts
applicationSteps: Form an organic farmer cluster with at least 20-50 local farmers.
Submit cluster proposal to the District Agriculture Officer / Regional Council.
Enroll on the PGS-India portal (pgsindia-ncof.gov.in).
Receive annual input grants, maintain peer reviews, and get green PGS organic certification.
schemes.howToApply: Through District Agriculture Officer, National Centre of Organic and Natural Farming, or jaivikkheti.in.
